title: Choose the new world for IPS
question: Premium, calm, told as one night shift. The roll assigned Turndown. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Turndown: the night housekeeping ritual
options.lineage: Five-star hotel night housekeeping: the turndown, the room card, the brass key fob
options.thesis: Every building IPS cleans gets the turndown a five-star hotel gives a suite: quietly prepared overnight, handed back at dawn.
materials: Scroll-scrubbed 3D office floor whose lights go out room by room
Heavy turndown card: site, time, crew, signed
Brass key-fob tags for site numbers
options.viewport: 18:00, dusk. A 3D office floor glows, tenants gone. Left: 'Lights off at six. Ready by seven.' in light engraved-plate caps, Get a quote as a turndown card.
options.risk: Hotel cues could read as hospitality-only or precious; type and copy must stay plain and commercial.

raised.raise: Light only where work is happening: at rest the night is dark, a floor lights when its crew starts and dims once signed off.
The night runs in numbered steps; finished steps ghost back, the current one is the only bright thing.
A time rail down the edge, 18:00 to 06:00, each section's height proportional to its share of the night.
Sign-off rows move in place and hold their mark; nothing pops or bounces in.
Honest names: the trade's real words (walkthrough, scope, sign-off), never marketing verbs.

options.label: The Handover Set
options.lineage: Architectural as-built drawings and the facility O&M handover manual
options.thesis: Facility managers live in floor plans: the night is drawn as a plan, each room hatched clean and signed off in the title block.
options.viewport: A full-bleed plan of a Perth office level; rooms fill in as the scroll moves through the night, title block carries the quote action.
options.risk: Familiar: blueprint-and-plan aesthetics are where many B2B pitches land, and it can feel cold and technical.

options.label: Night Flight Instruments
options.lineage: A light aircraft's night instrument panel
options.thesis: Handing over keys overnight is flying on instruments: six calm gauges show the client everything they can't see.
materials: Round SVG gauges with damped needles
options.viewport: A black panel of six gauges: sites tonight, crews on, sign-offs, issues, feedback, time to dawn.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity (systems made visible); loses on identification, as buyers aren't pilots.
options.risk: Can read as a dashboard gimmick rather than a story.

options.label: Boarding pass and gate board
options.thesis: The night's run sheet as a live departures board.
options.viewport: A departures board of sites ranked by sign-off time.
options.case: Fuses poorly: travel is off-audience and repeats the existing feed.
options.risk: Reads as an airline, not a contractor.
options.kept: Rows move in place and hold their change mark.

options.label: Acetate tab manual
options.thesis: Services as tabbed manual divisions under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Open manual at the Services tab.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful hues fight the premium brief.
options.kept: A proportional rail showing the whole extent.

options.label: Bioluminescent wake
options.thesis: Cleaning as light trails on black water.
options.viewport: Pointer draws glowing wakes over black.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neon-on-black is generic and says nothing about cleaning.
options.kept: Darkness at rest, light only where activity is.

options.label: Suminagashi ink basin
options.thesis: The page as a fluid ink surface.
options.viewport: A marbled basin answering the pointer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: ink spreading is the opposite of clean.
options.kept: Honest physical names for every control.

options.label: Brick build instructions
options.thesis: The service as numbered build steps.
options.viewport: Numbered steps assembling a clean office.
options.case: Fuses poorly: toy-like, exactly the cartoonish feel you want gone.
options.kept: Strict numbered sequence; finished steps ghost back.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A premium blue-and-white commercial cleaning site with crew photography, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero of a crew in a bright office, stats bar, service grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every Perth competitor by design.
